# Version 4.148.0
> **First stable v4 release** · Released June 22, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.148.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.148.0)

> **Supersedes [4.147.0](4.147.0.md)** · Rolls up preview-only work that was never released as stable — those changes are included cumulatively below.

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.148.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148 with updated lifecycle and pixel-access behavior. It rolls up the 4.147 preview line with variable fonts, animated WebP encoding, and surface-draw sampling, then adds a singleton lifecycle rework and pixel-span fixes. This is a breaking release; review the migration notes before upgrading from v3.

## Breaking Changes

- **Legacy SKPaint text and font members are compile errors** — Legacy SKPaint text and font state members previously marked obsolete are now compile errors, and remaining pre-v4 obsolete enum values are removed from the reference assembly. Move text sizing, typeface, hinting, and encoding to SKFont and use the SKCanvas.DrawText overloads that take SKFont. ([#4068](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4068), [#4114](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4114), [#4205](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4205))
- **Vulkan YCbCr conversion info type renamed** — GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo now uses GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo instead of GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo, and the old type's value-equality interface and operators are gone. Update type references and replace equality checks with explicit field comparisons where required.
- **SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose is read-only** — Derived classes can no longer change IgnorePublicDispose after construction because its protected setter has been removed. Configure disposal behavior through the constructor path instead. ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Default typeface null semantics changed** — An unset SKFont now contains SKTypeface.Empty, and SKPaint.Typeface and SKTypeface.Default provide non-null defaults. Construct SKFont with an explicit typeface when text must render, and use IsEmpty or SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily when distinguishing an unset or missing font.
- **SKStream.Move(long) rejects out-of-range offsets** — SKStream.Move(long) now throws OverflowException for values outside the native 32-bit offset range and is obsolete. Use Move(int) after validating or clamping larger offsets.
- **Ganesh Vulkan now requires Vulkan 1.1** — Creating a Ganesh Vulkan context with Vulkan 1.0 can terminate the process instead of returning null. Create the Vulkan instance at version 1.1 or later and set GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion to the same version; choose another backend up front for Vulkan 1.0-only hardware.
- **Vulkan backend native struct fields removed** — GRVkBackendContextNative no longer has fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, or fOwnsInstanceAndDevice, and its YCbCr conversion layout gains Components. Remove obsolete assignments and use fVkExtensions and fDeviceFeatures or fDeviceFeatures2 in their place.
- **Assembly version changed to 4.x** — SkiaSharp.dll now reports assembly version 4.148.0.0 rather than 3.119.0.0. Update strong-name binding redirects and hard-coded assembly-version checks.

## Engine

- **Skia upgraded to milestone m148** — The bundled engine now uses Skia m148 and includes upstream chrome/m147 bug-fix syncs from the v4 preview line. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3560](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3560), [#3660](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3660), [#3702](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3702), [#4044](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4044), [#4081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4081), [#4125](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4125))
- **Variable fonts and color font palettes** — Variable-font support is wired through SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, and SKFont and SKTypeface gain color-palette selection and more robust variable-font handling. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3703](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3703), [#3742](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3742))
- **Managed default typeface resolution** — Default typeface lookup now runs in the managed layer, avoiding failures on Android API 36 and restoring the legacy font-manager typeface factory. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3730](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3730), [#3744](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3744))

## API Surface

- **Sampling options for surface drawing** — SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface overloads accept SKSamplingOptions, allowing callers to select filtering and mipmap behavior. ([#3491](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3491))
- **Animated WebP encoding and zero-copy stream data** — SKWebpEncoder can create animated WebP files, while SKStream.GetData creates SKData from a seekable stream without an intermediate byte array. ([#3771](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3771), [#3772](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3772))
- **HarfBuzz color and wrapper APIs** — HarfBuzzSharp adds an HBColor value type and completes missing or inconsistently named binding wrappers. ([#4000](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4000), [#4001](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4001))

## Bug Fixes

- **Pixel spans honor row stride and coordinates** — SKPixmap and SKBitmap GetPixelSpan now use RowBytes for stride and calculate x/y offsets from Width, correcting reads from non-tightly packed bitmaps. ([#4128](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4128), [#4148](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4148))
- **SKPath finalizer ordering crash fixed** — Finalization no longer crashes when an SKPathBuilder is collected before an SKPath created from it. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3796](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3796))
- **Android and WinUI rendering startup fixes** — SKGLView correctly reattaches after MAUI TabBar switches on Android, and the WinUI Projection assembly is packaged for .NET 9 consumers. — ❤️ [@SimonvBez](https://github.com/SimonvBez) ([#3076](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3076), [#4084](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4084))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Singleton lifecycle reworked** — Process-wide singleton disposal and finalization now follow a managed lifecycle with predictable ownership; see the breaking changes above for migration guidance. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4080))
- **Native compatibility check runs on first API use** — The native-library compatibility gate moves from module initialization to the SkiaApi type constructor, improving AOT and trimming behavior and making startup failures easier to diagnose. ([#4133](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4133))

## Platform

- **Linux Bionic and 64-bit Tizen support** — Android-hosted Linux is supported through linux-bionic assets, and Tizen includes x64 and arm64 native builds. — ❤️ [@4Darmygeometry](https://github.com/4Darmygeometry) ([#3217](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3217), [#3620](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3620))
- **Apple framework alignment and WASM floor** — Libraries use versioned Apple TFMs while sample apps use unversioned TFMs, and WASM runtime assets now require .NET 8 or later. ([#3798](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3798), [#4022](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4022))

## Security

- **Bundled native dependencies refreshed** — The release updates libexpat, libpng, zlib, FreeType, libjpeg-turbo, and HarfBuzz to newer upstream versions. ([#3717](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3717), [#3718](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3718), [#3720](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3720), [#3726](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3726), [#4012](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4012), [#4035](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4035), [#4079](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4079))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0

HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 includes variable-font and color-palette work, the HBColor value type, and additional binding wrappers.
